patches.title: Unwrap the plugin tool envelope in MCP gateway responses
patches.problem: For a paperclip_plugin tool the gateway service returned the dispatcher envelope {pluginId, toolName, result: {content, data}}. The MCP route (server/src/routes/tool-gateway.ts) looked for data at the envelope level and answered structuredContent: null, with the whole envelope as text and isError: false even when the plugin refused. The Claude Code 2.1.322 MCP client rejects such a result whole ("structuredContent expected record, received null"), so every plugin tool (router, Discord Notifier, agent-ledger) was unusable for agents on the Claude engine (Dev Unity run 03ff8ab1, 13 Nov 2026). Codex 0.166.0 tolerated it and handed its agents the envelope as text.
patches.reason: Taken as is from the open upstream fix rather than a studio patch: the service returns the plugin's own result; the route sets structuredContent only for an object data, uses the plugin content as text, and turns a plugin error into isError: true with its message; the native Runner treats a plugin error the same way.
patches.owner: server tool gateway route, service and native-runtime assigned MCP tools

patches.problem: A per_user tool connection used a personal grant delegated to an agent only for runs without a responsible user (tool-gateway.ts resolveConnectionGrant, token-broker issuance). The Studio Secretary answers Fahd, whose Discord messages make him the responsible user of her runs (run-preparation.ts resolveResponsibleUserIdForRunSeed, comment author); Fahd never opens the board, so the Notion Reader connection, per_user with Amyne's grant only, stayed unusable for her (run aee047cf, 13 Nov 2026).
patches.reason: Amyne decided the Secretary reads Notion with his access (studio decision V185, 13 Nov 2026). Sharing the connection with the company is not acceptable: its finalize step rebinds the app profile to every active catalog entry (78, of which 39 write or destructive) for every agent. A second connection would start with its whole catalog enabled. A delegation names one owner, one grant, one connection and one agent, and changes no profile, policy or catalog.

patches.title: A plugin's own database calls are admitted without an invocation id while a non-agent invocation is active
patches.problem: plugin-worker-manager.ts contextForWorkerMessage refuses every worker-to-host call that carries no invocation id while any invocation of the plugin is active (Missing or unknown invocation scope). The Worker Router's native adapter reaches the plugin through its private channel, not through a host invocation, and its first host call is a read of its own registry (ctx.db.query). While the router's periodic job or any event or getData ran (16 to 36 s), those reads were refused: 41 router_control_scope_busy refusals between 05:45 and 06:25 UTC on 13 Nov 2026, delaying run admission and claim.
patches.reason: Approved by Amyne (studio decision V228, 13 Nov 2026). db.query and db.execute are confined to the plugin's namespace (plugin-database.ts) and hold no other company's data, so their result does not depend on the invocation's company. Agent-origin invocations keep the strict refusal, so no call made during an agent's tool call escapes its attribution.
patches.owner: server plugin worker host-call scoping
